context: When I book a work trip
barrier: but I need reliable Wi-Fi to work
goal: help me confirm the Wi-Fi is included and fast enough
outcome: so I can plan my day
importance_reason: Raised by 12 of 14 guests unprompted; a deal-breaker for business travellers.
satisfaction_reason: No complaints in 220 tickets; guests describe it as expected.
evidence: INT-02: Wi-Fi is the first thing I check. It's always been fine here. || INT-11: I don't even think about the Wi-Fi anymore, it just works.

barrier: but I don't know what the hotel can arrange
goal: help me add what I need before I arrive
importance_reason: Mentioned by 9 guests; matters most on first visits. Less 10: a leisure guest would rather sort it on arrival (INT-08).
satisfaction_reason: Guests describe finding out too late; funnel notes show low reach.
evidence: INT-05: I only found out about the airport transfer when I was already in the taxi. || FUN-01: Pre-arrival email: most guests never open the offer page.
contradicts: INT-08: I don't want emails before a trip, I'll sort things out when I get there.

context: When I arrive tired before my room is ready
goal: help me rest and freshen up
outcome: so I can start my day
importance_reason: Strong, repeated pain across 11 business travellers; front desk confirms daily.
satisfaction_reason: Current options (lobby, luggage store) described as poor by everyone who mentions them.
evidence: INT-03: I land at 7am and I'm sitting in the lobby until 3. || FD-02: Every morning there's a queue of red-eye guests asking if a room is ready. || INT-12: I changed in the gym toilets before a meeting. Not great.

barrier: but the room doesn't suit how I want to spend this stay
goal: help me find a room that fits this stay
outcome: so the stay feels worth it
importance_reason: Mentioned by 7 guests, mostly leisure stays of 2+ nights. Less 10: a leisure guest found the standard room fine (INT-10).
satisfaction_reason: Guests can't tell what they'd get; comparison step loses most people.
evidence: FUN-02: Upgrade page: most exits happen on the comparison step. || INT-09: I'd pay for a quieter room, but I couldn't tell which one was quiet.
contradicts: INT-10: Honestly the standard room was fine.

context: When I start my day short on time
importance_reason: Moderate; most have a workaround they're happy with.
satisfaction_reason: Grab-and-go coffee is mostly fine; few complaints.
evidence: INT-04: I grab a coffee and a pastry on the way, that does the job.

context: When I have a free evening in an unfamiliar city
barrier: but I don't know the area
goal: help me find something worth doing
outcome: so the trip feels like more than work
importance_reason: Mentioned by 8 guests, often with regret; only 2 sources from families.
satisfaction_reason: Current in-room offers rated as unhelpful; guests rely on luck.
evidence: INT-06: I ended up eating at the hotel bar three nights running because I didn't know where to go. || INT-13: The TV channel with hotel offers is useless, I just want a local tip.

context: When my flight is late in the day
goal: help me have a base until I leave
outcome: so I'm not hauling bags around
importance_reason: Raised by business and leisure guests alike; some already pay a full night as a workaround.
satisfaction_reason: Late checkout is rarely granted; guests describe the gap as stressful.
evidence: INT-09: We just pay for an extra night so we can keep the room. || INT-01: I spent four hours in a cafe with my suitcase. || SUP-204: Guest asked for 6pm checkout, declined, complaint logged.

barrier: but I don't recognise some charges
goal: help me see charges as they happen
importance_reason: Very high when it goes wrong; 38 tickets about disputed charges. No deduction for INT-14: it says the app works, which is about satisfaction.
satisfaction_reason: Mostly right; the app helps those who use it.
evidence: SUP-118: Guest disputed minibar and parking at checkout, 20 minutes to resolve. || INT-07: The bill is usually right, but when it isn't it ruins the end of the trip.
contradicts: INT-14: I check the app the night before, it's fine.

barrier: but I don't want to wait at the desk
goal: help me get my key without queuing
outcome: so I can go straight to my room
importance_reason: Rarely raised; check-in queues are short outside early mornings.
satisfaction_reason: Mobile key and desk both work well.
evidence: INT-02: Check-in was quick, no complaints. || INT-11: The mobile key is nice but I'd have been fine at the desk.
